title: Retail lending: floating-rate resets and release of property documents

borrower_notification.description: Borrower is told, before the next reset, the impact of a benchmark-rate reset on EMI or tenor.

emi_or_tenor_choice.description: Borrower may choose between an EMI increase, a tenor extension or a combination after a reset.

fixed_rate_option.description: Borrower may switch a floating-rate loan to a fixed rate at reset.

reset_statement.description: Statement with principal, interest, EMI, tenor and APR issued to the borrower at each reset.

document_release_sla.description: Original property documents are released within 30 days of full repayment.

delay_compensation.description: Statutory compensation is paid automatically for each day of delay in releasing documents.

document_collection_choice.description: Borrower may choose where original documents are collected.

record_flags.borrower_notified: Borrower was told the EMI/tenor impact of the last reset.
record_flags.has_fixed_rate_option: Loan offers a switch to a fixed rate.
record_flags.has_emi_tenor_choice: Borrower may choose EMI increase or tenor extension.
record_flags.statement_available: Reset statement with principal, interest and APR issued.

vw_compliance_impact.description: One row per loan. Opaque refs only; no names, contact or account numbers.

columns.borrower_notified: boolean - Borrower was told the EMI/tenor impact of the last reset.
columns.has_fixed_rate_option: boolean - Loan offers a switch to a fixed rate.
columns.has_emi_tenor_choice: boolean - Borrower may choose EMI increase or tenor extension.
columns.statement_available: boolean - Reset statement with principal, interest and APR issued.

vw_loan_events.description: Operational event log per loan, tokenized.

vw_branch_directory.description: Branch metadata without manager contact details.

workflows.SEND_BORROWER_NOTICE: Customer Communications sends a templated notice to each borrower in the worklist.
workflows.BRANCH_MANAGER_ALERT: Alert branch managers with the per-branch worklist.
workflows.PRODUCT_CONTROL_CHANGE: Raise a change request with the product owner to add a missing control.
workflows.COMPENSATION_PAYOUT_REVIEW: Finance reviews and approves statutory delay compensation.
